title: What's new in v2.7.0
summary: Upgrade a whole site's firmware on your schedule, in an order that keeps the network up.

steps.title: Firmware Rollout
steps.listLabel: Upgrade your whole site without babysitting it
steps.body: Upgrade every device on a site while intelligently maximizing network availability, at the most optimal time according to the site's traffic history. One device per model goes first and the rest wait on how it went: actually running the new firmware, and steady on its own CPU, memory and health stats. Hold one model back on Official, push another to Early Access, or leave a device out entirely. Switch on **Autopilot** and it does all of this on its own, every time new firmware lands - with a heads-up first, and a way to stop it.
